text:
maya: Quick sync: proposing a "Tenant Shield" routing policy — deterministic latency + data isolation for regulated customers. Phased approach: feature-flag + dedicated lanes + gradual capacity commitments. Need product + infra + sales alignment. Thoughts?

samir: +1 on the idea. Biggest risk: GPU pool fragmentation. Need to model token-ex/sec impact. Ballpark cost multiplier? ~1.6x if we reserve small pools per tenant.

eli: For SLOs we need 99.9% p95 for <200ms across common prompts. Can we commit to that for phase 1? Also fallback behavior when dedicated lane is saturated?

taylor: Sales have a request from AcmeCorp and HealthCo for an isolation guarantee. They want an opt-in contract clause. Legal is engaged; they asked for audit logs + KMS separation. We'll need launch checklist items.

maya: agree on SLO. Proposal: Phase 1 (MVP) = per-tenant virtual lane (router-level affinity) + soft capacity cap + fallback to shared lane with degrade policy + audit logging. Phase 2 = hard isolation (dedicated pools), per-tenant KMS + SLA. Timeline: MVP in 10 weeks.

samir: technical constraints: router needs policy table + on-call hooks. Suggest we start with policy-as-config prototype using the existing routing DSL. Example proto:
```
policy "tenant_shield" {
  match: tenant in ["AcmeCorp","HealthCo"]
  route: preferred_lane: "shield-pool-v1"
  fallback: shared_lane
  soft_limit: 75% // start throttling, not rejecting
}
```

eli: Fallback semantics must preserve conversational continuity — prefer prefix-preservation and explicit warning header for apps. Also tie to tracing so we can flag quality regressions.

taylor: Commercial ask: enable feature-flag gate + opt-in billing SKU. Sales can pilot with 2 customers if we can promise data plane isolation for keys and logs retention config.

maya: Action items:
- samir: cost model + capacity sim for 3 pool sizes (due EOW)
- eli: define SLO & fallback contract language + tracing hooks (due next Tue)
- taylor: capture customer ask + legal checklist (due EOW)
- maya: draft launch acceptance criteria and rollout plan (due Thu)

ops-bot: Deployed canary router config to dev cluster at 2025-11-02T09:02:11Z :rocket:

samir: noted. I'll start with a simple sim and share numbers in the channel. Expecting ~1.5-1.8x cost for isolated soft-lane depending on hit rate.

eli: I'll draft the SLO doc and include example monitoring dashboards (latency, token-per-request delta, fallback rate).

taylor: I'll line up customer pilots and get legal inputs. Thanks!

maya: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to lock acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
